findings: The printed formula of lactic acid, C2H6O3, is C3H6O3 in the lesson, matching the printed equation 2(C3H6O3); the figure's product label 'Ethyl alcohol' under lactic acid is a printed slip.
The substrate-level phosphorylation reaction (PEP + ADP to pyruvic acid + ATP) is a structural drawing in print; the lesson states it in words.
The 36 ATP balance follows the textbook (3 ATP per NADH, 2 per FADH2, 1 ATP transport cost per glycolytic NADH).
